name: Intuitive Spellcaster
body:
Spellcasting has always come naturally to you.

Prerequisites: Caster level 1

Benefit: You gain +4 caster levels in a spellcasting class, to a maximum of your current Hit Dice.

Special: You may take this multiple times. You may not select the same class.
